lifecycle.evidence_stage: same-family phenotype extension plus multi-omics candidate prioritization
lifecycle.key_results: New DON QTL in this family; Wuhan 1 favorable allele; 11.52-Mb interval; eight intersected candidates, with TraesCS1A01G426000 highlighted.
lifecycle.interpretation_boundary: Candidate prioritization does not establish the causal gene; the experiment adds a phenotype/time-point layer to one population family.

lifecycle.evidence_stage: same-family temporal confirmation plus multi-omics candidate prioritization
lifecycle.key_results: 4BS region was detected at 2 dpi and had a trans-eQTL hotspot; TraesCS4B01G024600 was highlighted.
lifecycle.interpretation_boundary: Confirmation is within the same Wuhan 1 x Nyubai family and is not independent replication.

lifecycle.evidence_stage: same-family temporal confirmation with low-resolution physical projection
lifecycle.key_results: Nyubai favorable allele; source physical projection spans 21.67-461.45 Mb across the centromere.
lifecycle.interpretation_boundary: The broad interval cannot support gene-level localization; two intersected genes remain candidates only.

curation_labels.details_zh: 原文把跨着丝粒的一-LOD区间投影为21.67–461.45 Mb；区间宽约439.78 Mb。作者明确归因于着丝粒附近低重组和标记/基因密度下降。
curation_labels.verifiable_fact: Author-reported RefSeq v1.0 physical projection spans 439.78 Mb across the centromere; it is not gene-level localization.

lifecycle.key_results: Fhb1 effects differed between CDC Alsask and CDC Go backgrounds; single-gene classes did not uniformly improve every phenotype in both backgrounds.
lifecycle.interpretation_boundary: Validation is background- and phenotype-dependent; the paper does not support a universal additive effect.

lifecycle.key_results: Fhb2 effects differed between CDC Alsask and CDC Go backgrounds; single-gene classes did not uniformly improve every phenotype in both backgrounds.
lifecycle.interpretation_boundary: Validation is background- and phenotype-dependent; the paper does not support a universal additive effect.

lifecycle.key_results: Fhb5 effects differed between CDC Alsask and CDC Go backgrounds; single-gene classes did not uniformly improve every phenotype in both backgrounds.
lifecycle.interpretation_boundary: Validation is background- and phenotype-dependent; the paper does not support a universal additive effect.

lifecycle.key_results: The three-gene class reduced field incidence/severity/index/DON by 9/32/37/49% in CDC Alsask and 14/20/26/40% in CDC Go relative to recurrent parents; combinations were not uniformly additive.
lifecycle.interpretation_boundary: No three-gene NIL matched the resistant donor/check; residual minor loci and significant marker interactions remained.

lifecycle.evidence_stage: same-family marker enrichment and fine mapping
lifecycle.key_results: The source re-mapped the region to 5.3 cM between IWB5988 and IWA5087, with IWB63138 as the closest marker and R2=12%.
lifecycle.interpretation_boundary: This is a refinement of the 2016 02-5B-318 x Saragolla population, not an independent QTL discovery; no RefSeq v1.0 physical interval is reported.

lifecycle.evidence_stage: candidate-gene sequence, expression, haplotype and targeted-mutant support
lifecycle.key_results: Resistant and susceptible parents/selected RILs differed in WAK2 sequence and expression; three predicted WAK2 loss-of-function mutant lines showed severe FHB symptoms in the source assay.
lifecycle.interpretation_boundary: Strong functional support is retained, while two internal reporting differences are exposed for source-level checking; the database does not infer a modern physical QTL interval from the candidate gene.

curation_labels.details_zh: 数据库仅记录两项原文内部差异：表2把Kronos3340和Kronos4209列为het，而方法称用于测定的靶突变植株经测序选为纯合；表2给Kronos3965的SIFT为0.87，而结果段称三个WAK2突变均SIFT<0.05。数据库不据此否定作者结论。
verifiable_facts: Table 2 labels WAK2 mutants Kronos3340 and Kronos4209 as heterozygous, whereas the Methods says plants carrying targeted mutations in homozygous status were selected by sequencing.
Table 2 reports SIFT=0.87 for Kronos3965, whereas the Results text says all three WAK2 mutations had SIFT scores <0.05.

lifecycle.key_results: Peak 59.9 cM, interval 55.9-67.4 cM, LOD 15.99 and PVE 55.5% in 104 DH lines.
lifecycle.interpretation_boundary: No physical QTL boundaries were reported; this is a re-analysis of the established Wuhan 1 x Nyubai family.

lifecycle.key_results: TraesCS2D02G440500 eQTL overlapped the FHB genetic interval; UN25696 was nearby; expression was associated with lower symptoms.
lifecycle.interpretation_boundary: The authors explicitly require gene silencing or overexpression; neither candidate coordinate is treated as the physical QTL boundary.

enrichment.null_model: chromosome-stratified random placement preserving each locus width and chromosome; point records remain zero-width points
enrichment.interpretation_limit: Overlap validates positional recurrence, not causality. Broad LD/linkage spans increase expected random overlap and are preserved in the null model.

sensitivity.primary_null_model: For each dataset family and chromosome, apply one random circular shift to every locus, preserving within-family chromosome-specific widths, counts, clustering and relative spacing; split wrapped intervals at chromosome boundaries.
sensitivity.interpretation: Family-level inference is primary for independence. Locus-level P-values are descriptive because multiple loci within a data family are correlated.
